svg.title: vLLM KV cache groups: from a layer to a token slot
svg.desc: Two full attention layers and four sliding window layers become three groups of two layers. Layer S2 is position 1 of group 1. Request R has eight tokens, two per block. In the group 1 block table, the cell for tokens 4 and 5 points to block ID 5.
svg.text: 1 · Layer S2 → its group → the block table of request R
2 full + 4 sliding window layers · 3 groups of 2 layers · pos = position inside the group
request R has 8 tokens t0–t7 · one block holds 2 tokens · one table cell = one block
window 4 keeps only t4–t7, so the t0–t3 cells of sliding groups are null
S2 reads t4 t5 → the group 1 cell for t4 t5 → block ID 5
